headline: INOX India files draft IPO papers with SEBI
hook: INOX India moves toward public listing
summary: INOX India has officially filed its draft red herring prospectus (DRHP) with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) to initiate its initial public offering. The company is moving forward with its plans to raise capital through the primary market. This filing marks the formal start of the regulatory review process for the IPO. Retail investors should track the upcoming approval status and price band announcements.
whats_next: SEBI observations and approval of the DRHP
why_it_matters: New investment opportunity in the industrial manufacturing sector.
